# The New York Times

> > The New York Times is a global news organization providing breaking news, in-depth reporting, and analysis across politics, international affairs, business, sports, culture, and lifestyle from 150+ countries.

The New York Times operates multiple news hubs and specialized platforms including international editions, sports coverage through The Athletic, recipes through NYT Cooking, and product reviews via Wirecutter. The organization employs 1,700+ journalists covering major global events including Middle East conflicts, US politics, and geopolitical developments.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- International News
- Middle East Conflict
- Iran-Israel Relations
- US Politics
- Geopolitics
- Live Coverage
- Energy Crisis
- Global Economy
- NCAA Tournament
- Sports Coverage
- Opinion & Analysis
- Recipes & Cooking
- Product Reviews
- Investigative Journalism

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [The New York Times - Breaking News, US News, World News and Videos](https://www.nytimes.com): NYT homepage with breaking news from 150+ countries covering politics, business, tech, health, sports.
- [The New York Times International - Breaking News, US News, World News, Videos](https://www.nytimes.com/international): International news hub with 1,700 journalists reporting on global politics, business, and geopolitics.
- [Today's Paper - The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/section/todayspaper): Daily newspaper front page with top news highlights, politics, international news, and entertainment.

## Regional & International Editions

- [The New York Times Canada - Breaking News, US News, World News, Videos](https://www.nytimes.com/ca): Canada-focused news section covering US, Canadian, and global news from 150+ countries.
- [纽约时报中文网 国际纵览](https://cn.nytimes.com): Chinese-language NYT service with translated and original reporting on global news and business.

## Sports & Live Events

- [The Athletic - Sports news, stories, scores, schedules, podcasts, and more](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic): Sports hub covering NCAA, NBA, NHL, WNBA with breaking news, stories, and live coverage.
- [Men's March Madness 2026 second round scores, live updates: Michigan vs. Saint Louis](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/live-blogs/march-madness-2026-mens-second-round-live-updates-scores-results-bracket/2t4xV8jWuQBS): Live coverage of NCAA Tournament March Madness second round with scores and game updates.

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Opinion - The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/section/opinion): Opinion section with columnists Brooks, Dowd, Blow, Krugman and editorial board commentary.

## Lifestyle & Consumer Content

- [NYT Cooking - Recipes and Cooking Guides From The New York Times](https://cooking.nytimes.com): Recipe database with thousands of NYT recipes and cooking guides for all skill levels.
- [Wirecutter: New Product Reviews, Deals, and Buying Advice](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter): Product review and buying guide site for tech, appliances, home goods with expert recommendations.

## Data & Interactive Tools

- [President Trump Approval Rating: Latest Polls  - The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/polls/donald-trump-approval-rating-polls.html): Interactive poll tracker for Trump approval ratings, 2026 elections, and Senate polling data.

## Optional

- [Tips - The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/tips): Secure tip submission page with Signal, Tor, SecureDrop for confidential journalist contact.
